changelog: **ID card tracker.** The tracker is now a compact ID card with the gold border: a square portrait in a thin gold frame, your name in class color, <Alchemists>, level, class, and your role icon, then the Status buttons and a stats strip. **Collapsed by default, with an expand tab.** The card starts collapsed. **Shown by default.** Every character gets the tracker shown once with this update, even if an earlier `/codex mini` hid it. **Bigger main window.** The default is now 560 x 800, capped at 85% of your screen height. **The namecard is built in two phases.** Phase 1 always makes a plain card: solid background, gold border lines, portrait, name, and the status buttons, anchored under the minimap. **Show tracker button.** The main window header has a new alchemy button that rebuilds the namecard and puts it under the minimap, the same as `/codex mini reset`. **Clearer slash commands.** Extra spaces and capitals no longer matter. **Version in the header.** The main window shows "Alchemists · v1.18.2" under the title, so you can confirm which copy the game loaded.
